FROM qualifying q
JOIN lap_times lt ON q.qualkey = lt.rc_index
WHERE q.px_pos = 1
GROUP BY q.qualkey, q.rbind, q.pilotrec, q.px_pos
LIMIT 20;

FROM qualifying q
JOIN lap_times lt ON q.qualkey = lt.rc_index
WHERE q.rbind = 18
GROUP BY q.qualkey, q.rbind, q.pilotrec, q.px_pos
ORDER BY q.px_pos;

-- Check: race 18, pole driver has best_msec = 89168 ms = 89.168s. That seems reasonable for a lap time.
-- Let's compute deficit for each driver in race 18
SELECT q.qualkey, q.rbind, q.pilotrec, q.px_pos, 
       MIN(lt.msec_val) as best_msec,
       MIN(lt.msec_val) - 89168 as deficit_ms,
       ROUND(CAST((MIN(lt.msec_val) - 89168) AS numeric) / 1000, 2) as deficit_s
FROM qualifying q
JOIN lap_times lt ON q.qualkey = lt.rc_index
WHERE q.rbind = 18
GROUP BY q.qualkey, q.rbind, q.pilotrec, q.px_pos
ORDER BY q.px_pos;

WHERE lt.rc_index IN (SELECT qualkey FROM qualifying WHERE rbind = 18)
ORDER BY lt.rc_index, lt.lapval;

-- How many distinct races have qualifying entries?

WITH driver_best AS (
    SELECT q.qualkey, q.rbind, q.pilotrec, MIN(lt.msec_val) as best_msec
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN lap_times lt ON q.qualkey = lt.rc_index
    GROUP BY q.qualkey, q.rbind, q.pilotrec
),
-- Step 2: Get pole position best time per race
pole_time AS (
    SELECT db.rbind, db.best_msec as pole_msec
    FROM driver_best db
    JOIN qualifying q ON db.qualkey = q.qualkey AND db.rbind = q.rbind AND db.pilotrec = q.pilotrec
    WHERE q.px_pos = 1
),
-- Step 3: Calculate deficit for each driver in each race
deficits AS (
    SELECT db.pilotrec as driver_id, 
           ROUND(CAST((db.best_msec - pt.pole_msec) AS numeric) / 1000, 2) as deficit_s
    FROM driver_best db
    JOIN pole_time pt ON db.rbind = pt.rbind
)
SELECT driver_id, AVG(deficit_s) as avg_deficit
FROM deficits
GROUP BY driver_id
ORDER BY avg_deficit
LIMIT 20;
